title: Grateful Dead Live at Golden Hall, Community Concourse on 1982-02-19
lineage: Sony ECM200T> SonyTCD5> C> NakDR1> PCM> PC> CoolEditBass Boost> DAT> CDR

ai_review.summary: Muddy audience recording that sounds like it was captured from the parking lot, yet the show contains a rare pre‑drums jam with enough energy to make it worthwhile.
ai_review.review: The audio quality is poor – distant mics render most instruments inaudible and only Jerry's guitar cuts through at times.  Despite the technical flaws, listeners note a unique pre‑drums jam that adds some excitement not found on other copies of this show.

ai_rating.rationale: Mixed reviewer sentiment (1★, 3★, 4★) and consistently negative comments about recording quality lower the overall score despite a few positive remarks about performance energy.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Distant audience mics; instruments often buried or muffled, Jerry's guitar occasionally audible. Sounds like it was recorded from the parking lot with significant clarity loss.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Hard to assess due to audio limitations, but the pre‑drums jam segment is highlighted as a notable moment.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Guitar sometimes the only clear instrument; overall tone buried by distant mics.
